_about: Hand-written entries for the relocated-API table (tools/relocated.py). Only what Blizzard's own transition guide and deprecation shims in the client don't cover. 'old' is the classic 1.15 call, 'new' the Forever replacement(s); the tool checks every name against the in-game dump, so a wrong name here shows up as not-in-game. 'classic' is the classic signature, 'change' how arguments and returns differ, in plain words.

entries.classic: name, rank, icon, castTime, minRange, maxRange, spellID, originalIcon = GetSpellInfo(spellID | name)
entries.change: Returns one SpellInfo table (name, iconID, originalIconID, castTime, minRange, maxRange, spellID) instead of eight values, and no rank. For just the name or icon, C_Spell.GetSpellName / C_Spell.GetSpellTexture are cheaper. Rank text: C_Spell.GetSpellSubtext.

entries.classic: start, duration, enabled, modRate = GetSpellCooldown(spellID | name)
entries.change: Returns one SpellCooldownInfo table (startTime, duration, isEnabled, modRate) instead of four values. The spell book form moved to C_SpellBook.GetSpellBookItemCooldown(index, spellBank).

entries.classic: name, link, quality, itemLevel, minLevel, type, subType, stackCount, equipLoc, texture, sellPrice, classID, subclassID, bindType, expansionID, setID, isCraftingReagent = GetItemInfo(item)
entries.change: Same returns in the same order, plus an 18th (itemDescription). Same argument (item ID, name or link). Still returns nothing until the item is cached: wait for ITEM_DATA_LOAD_RESULT / GET_ITEM_INFO_RECEIVED, or use C_Item.GetItemInfoInstant for the fields that need no cache.
